This action follows Goldsmith's felony conviction for introducing misbranded drugs into interstate commerce. Goldsmith failed to respond to a notice proposing debarment, thereby waiving his right to a hearing. The debarment is effective as of September 19, 2025.
events.title: William Goldsmith Debarred from Drug Importation
events.why_relevant: This debarment order enforces regulatory compliance and integrity in drug importation, protecting public health and safety.
